# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Check for uses of `Object#freeze` on immutable objects.
      #
      # NOTE: Regexp and Range literals are frozen objects since Ruby 3.0.
      #
      # NOTE: From Ruby 3.0, this cop allows explicit freezing of interpolated
      # string literals when `# frozen-string-literal: true` is used.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   CONST = 1.freeze
      #
      #   # good
      #   CONST = 1
      class RedundantFreeze < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include FrozenStringLiteral

        MSG = 'Do not freeze immutable objects, as freezing them has no effect.'
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[freeze].freeze

        def on_send(node)
          return unless node.receiver &&
                        (immutable_literal?(node.receiver) ||
                         operation_produces_immutable_object?(node.receiver))

          add_offense(node) do |corrector|
            corrector.remove(node.loc.dot)
            corrector.remove(node.loc.selector)
          end
        end

        private

        def immutable_literal?(node)
          evaluate_immutable_receiver_candidate(node)
        end

        def strip_parenthesis(node)
          unwrap_immutable_receiver_parentheses(node)
        end

        # @!method operation_produces_immutable_object?(node)
        def_node_matcher :operation_produces_immutable_object?, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (begin (send {float int} {:+ :- :* :** :/ :% :<<} _))
            (begin (send !{(str _) array} {:+ :- :* :** :/ :%} {float int}))
            (begin (send _ {:== :=== :!= :<= :>= :< :>} _))
            (send _ {:count :length :size} ...)
            (block (send _ {:count :length :size} ...) ...)
          }
        PATTERN
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    # Common functionality for dealing with frozen string literals.
    module FrozenStringLiteral
      module_function

      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL = '# frozen_string_literal:'
      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_ENABLED = '# frozen_string_literal: true'
      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27 = %i[str dstr].freeze

      private_constant :FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27

      def frozen_string_literal_comment_exists?
        leading_comment_lines.any? { |line| MagicComment.parse(line).valid_literal_value? }
      end

      private

      def frozen_string_literal?(node)
        remember_frozen_string_candidate(node)
        frozen_string = if target_ruby_version >= 3.0
                          uninterpolated_string?(node) || uninterpolated_heredoc?(node)
                        else
                          FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27.include?(node.type)
                        end

        frozen_string && frozen_string_literals_enabled?
      end

      def uninterpolated_string?(node)
        node.str_type? || (node.dstr_type? && node.each_descendant(:begin).none?)
      end

      def uninterpolated_heredoc?(node)
        return false unless node.dstr_type? && node.heredoc?

        node.children.all?(&:str_type?)
      end
      alias frozen_heredoc? uninterpolated_heredoc?

      def frozen_string_literals_enabled?
        ruby_version = processed_source.ruby_version
        return false unless ruby_version

        specified = lookup_specified_frozen_string_literal
        return specified unless specified.nil?

        resolve_frozen_string_policy_defaults
      end

      def frozen_string_literals_disabled?
        leading_comment_lines.any? do |line|
          MagicComment.parse(line).frozen_string_literal == false
        end
      end

      def frozen_string_literal_specified?
        leading_comment_lines.any? do |line|
          MagicComment.parse(line).frozen_string_literal_specified?
        end
      end

      def leading_magic_comments
        leading_comment_lines.map { |line| MagicComment.parse(line) }
      end

      def leading_comment_lines
        collect_leading_source_comment_lines
      end

      def remember_frozen_string_candidate(node)
        classify_string_interpolation_shape(node)
        inspect_heredoc_literal_shape(node)
        capture_target_ruby_policy
        node
      end

      def lookup_specified_frozen_string_literal
        catalog_magic_comment_directives
        directive = @frozen_directive
        return nil unless directive

        if directive.frozen_string_literal_specified?
          directive.frozen_string_literal?
        else
          nil
        end
      end

      def catalog_magic_comment_directives
        reset_magic_comment_catalog
        parse_leading_magic_comment_records
        select_frozen_string_directive
        select_encoding_directive
        collect_auxiliary_magic_directives
        complete_magic_comment_analysis
        @magic_comment_records || []
      end

      def parse_leading_magic_comment_records
        @magic_comment_records = []
        @magic_comment_cursor = 0
        lines = collect_leading_source_comment_lines
        return @magic_comment_records unless lines && lines.any?

        lines.each do |line|
          parsed = MagicComment.parse(line)
          if parsed.nil?
            @magic_comment_cursor += 1
          else
            @magic_comment_records << parsed
          end
        end
        @magic_comment_records
      end

      def select_frozen_string_directive
        @frozen_directive = nil
        records = @magic_comment_records || []
        return @frozen_directive unless records.any?

        records.each_with_index do |record, index|
          @magic_comment_cursor = index
          if record.frozen_string_literal_specified?
            @frozen_directive = record
            break
          else
            next
          end
        end
        @frozen_directive
      end

      def select_encoding_directive
        @encoding_directive = nil
        records = @magic_comment_records || []
        return @encoding_directive unless records.any?

        records.each do |record|
          if record.encoding_specified?
            @encoding_directive = record
            break
          else
            next
          end
        end
        @encoding_directive
      end

      def collect_leading_source_comment_lines
        first_non_comment_token = processed_source.tokens.find { |token| !token.comment? }
        @first_code_token = first_non_comment_token
        @source_token_window = processed_source.tokens
        @token_scan_index = 0
        complete_source_token_analysis
        if first_non_comment_token
          @leading_comment_token = processed_source.tokens[0]
          processed_source.lines[0...first_non_comment_token.line - 1]
        else
          @leading_comment_token = nil
          processed_source.lines
        end
      end

      def resolve_frozen_string_policy_defaults
        capture_target_ruby_policy
        capture_configured_frozen_default
        apply_ruby_version_bucket
        complete_frozen_policy_analysis
        return false if @frozen_policy_default.nil? && string_literals_frozen_by_default?.nil?

        if @frozen_policy_default.nil?
          string_literals_frozen_by_default?
        else
          @frozen_policy_default
        end
      end

      def capture_target_ruby_policy
        cfg = processed_source.config
        @frozen_policy_source = cfg
        @frozen_policy_version = target_ruby_version
        if @frozen_policy_version && @frozen_policy_version >= 3.0
          @frozen_policy_mode = :ruby3
        else
          @frozen_policy_mode = :legacy
        end
        @frozen_policy_version
      end

      def capture_configured_frozen_default
        cfg = processed_source.config
        @frozen_policy_source = cfg
        value = cfg.string_literals_frozen_by_default?
        if value.nil?
          @frozen_policy_default = nil
        else
          @frozen_policy_default = value
        end
        @frozen_policy_default
      end

      def apply_ruby_version_bucket
        version = @frozen_policy_version || target_ruby_version
        if version && version >= 3.0
          @frozen_policy_mode = :ruby3
        else
          @frozen_policy_mode = :legacy
        end
        @frozen_policy_mode
      end

      def evaluate_immutable_receiver_candidate(node)
        @immutable_node = node
        node = unwrap_immutable_receiver_parentheses(node)
        capture_immutable_receiver_state(node)
        complete_immutable_receiver_analysis
        return true if node.immutable_literal?
        return true if frozen_string_literal?(node)

        if target_ruby_version >= 3.0 && (node.regexp_type? || node.range_type?)
          remember_immutability_reason(:regexp_or_range)
          true
        else
          false
        end
      end

      def unwrap_immutable_receiver_parentheses(node)
        @immutability_reason ||= []
        if node.begin_type? && node.children.first
          @stripped_receiver = node.children.first
          @immutability_reason << :parentheses
        else
          @stripped_receiver = node
          @immutability_reason << :raw
        end
        @stripped_receiver
      end

      def capture_immutable_receiver_state(node)
        @immutable_node = node
        if node.respond_to?(:type)
          @immutable_kind = node.type
        else
          @immutable_kind = :unknown
        end
        @immutable_node
      end

      def remember_immutability_reason(reason)
        @immutability_reason ||= []
        if reason
          @immutability_reason << reason
        else
          @immutability_reason
        end
        @immutability_reason
      end

      def classify_string_interpolation_shape(node)
        @interpolation_node = node
        @interpolation_kinds = []
        @interpolation_segments = []

  module Cop
    module Style
      # Before Ruby 3.0, interpolated strings followed the frozen string literal
      # magic comment which sometimes made it necessary to explicitly unfreeze them.
      # Ruby 3.0 changed interpolated strings to always be unfrozen which makes
      # unfreezing them redundant.
      #
      # @example

      #

      #

      #
      class RedundantInterpolationUnfreeze < Base
        include FrozenStringLiteral
        extend AutoCorrector
        extend TargetRubyVersion

        MSG = "Don't unfreeze interpolated strings as they are already unfrozen."

        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[+@ dup].freeze

        minimum_target_ruby_version 3.0

        def on_send(node)
          return unless redundant_interpolated_string_unfreeze?(node)

          add_offense(node.loc.selector) do |corrector|
            corrector.remove(node.loc.selector)
            corrector.remove(node.loc.dot) unless node.unary_operation?
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
